name: SPT Item Creator Item Package
teaser: Some item data files suitable for the SPTItemCreator mod.
description:
English

Some item data files suitable for the SPTItemCreator mod.

Simply ensure all new item data files are located in the /game folder/SPT/user/mods/SptItemCreator/data directory, and that the file extensions conform to the types specified in the Wiki (e.g., .sic.jsonc). The system supports traversing files within subdirectories of this folder.

Installation Method

Extract to the game folder.

To avoid generating too many plugins from different types of item data files, all the items I create will generally be released under this single plugin.

中文

一些适合SPTItemCreator模组的物品数据文件

只需要保证所有新物品数据文件处于游戏文件夹/SPT/user/mods/SptItemCreator/data文件夹下，且文件扩展名符合Wiki中规定的类型即可(如 .sic.jsonc)即可(支持遍历该文件夹的子目录中的文件)

安装方式

解压到游戏文件夹

为了避免不同类的物品数据文件创建的插件过多，一般情况下所有我做的物品都将在这一个插件下发布

versions.description:
English

These new items are overpowered; please use them with caution.

Assault Booster Elixir: Medical item, ID 5f9d9b8e6f8b4a1e3c7d5a2b. Weight 0.4 kg, size 1x1 slot, rarity “Rare”. Provides 12 beneficial effects, including: +25% health regeneration rate, +10% Strength skill, +3.6x carrying capacity, +30 Metabolism skill, +30 Health skill, +30 Vitality skill, +30 Endurance skill, +30 stress resistance, +45 maximum stamina, +1.5 stamina recovery rate, 15% damage reduction, +1 hydration recovery rate, +1 energy recovery rate. Effects last 900 seconds, includes 900 seconds of pain suppression. Trader price 260,000 RUB, Flea Market price 280,000 RUB.

Stamina Recovery Elixir: Medical item, ID 6900c8e93ea877662a000013. Weight 0.4 kg, size 1x1 slot, rarity “Rare”. Main effect is +12x stamina recovery rate for 10 seconds, includes 5 seconds of hand tremor removal. Trader price 170,000 RUB, Flea Market price 190,000 RUB.

Formula 555: Medical item, ID 5f9d9b8e6f8b4a1e3c7d5a30. Weight 1 kg, size 1x1 slot, rarity “Rare”. Provides periodic enhancement effects, geometrically boosting Strength, Perception, Endurance, and Attention skills across five stages, starting from +4 up to +64. Total duration exceeds 33.55 million seconds. Trader price 335,503.36 RUB, Flea Market price is the same.

Undetectable Extension Pouch (9x9): Container item, ID 5f9d9b8e6f8b4a1e30000001. Weight -5 kg (reduces carried weight), size 1x1 slot, rarity “Common”. Provides 9x9 storage grid, total capacity 81 slots. Supports storing items in-raid, can be placed inside Secure Containers, and can be nested within itself. Trader price 666,666 RUB, Flea Market price 706,666 RUB.

体力恢复药剂：医疗物品，ID为6900c8e93ea877662a000013。重量0.4千克，尺寸1x1格，稀有度“稀有“。主要效果为12倍的耐力恢复速度提升，持续10秒，附带5秒的手部震颤消除效果。商人售价170,000卢布，跳蚤市场价格190,000卢布。

五五五药剂：医疗物品，ID为5f9d9b8e6f8b4a1e3c7d5a30。重量1千克，尺寸1x1格，稀有度“稀有“。提供周期性增强效果，对力量、感知、耐力、注意力四项技能分五个阶段进行几何级数提升，从4开始逐步增加到64，总持续时间超过3355万秒。商人售价335,503.36卢布，跳蚤市场价格相同。
